# settings name the classifier under the orchestrator, and a key model with no key asks for the key without showing it
type /settings
key enter
key right
wait Classifier model
screen
key down
key enter
wait typesafe · no key
key down
screen
key enter
wait TYPESAFE_API_KEY
type ts-made-up-4d1e9a7c
absent 4d1e
screen
key esc
absent TYPESAFE_API_KEY
key enter
paste ts-made-up-4d1e9a7c
wait •••••••••••••••••••█
key enter
wait classifier now runs typesafe/jev-latest
absent 4d1e
screen
